sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
player = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'O':
        player = n
        break

if player:
    b = player['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
    pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
    print(f"Player: row={pr}, col={pc}")

# Get bird positions
yellow_birds = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] == 3]
print(f"Bird count: {len(yellow_birds)}")
birds = []
for b in yellow_birds:
    b_rows = [p[0] for p in b['boundary']]
    b_cols = [p[1] for p in b['boundary']]
    br = (min(b_rows)+max(b_rows))/2
    bc = (min(b_cols)+max(b_cols))/2
    dist = ((br - pr)**2 + (bc - pc)**2)**0.5
    birds.append((br, bc, dist))
    print(f"  Bird: row={br}, col={bc}, dist={dist:.1f}")

# The player's row is stuck at 36.0. Let me try using MOUSE to move the player to a bird's position.
# The nearest bird is at row=38.5, col=51.5 (dist=22.6 from player at col=29.5)
# Let me try clicking on the bird to see if the player moves there or if the bird is collected.

print("\nTrying MOUSE on nearest bird at row=38, col=51:")
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 38, 'col': 51}])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'O':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
        pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
        print(f"Player after MOUSE: row={pr}, col={pc}")
        break

yellow_birds = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] == 3]
print(f"Bird count after MOUSE: {len(yellow_birds)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
